scope: Identification path transport and idXML FileHandler dispatch; existing record adapter retained. Other identification formats and inherited schema/logging APIs remain.
source_rules: XMLFile parse_ detects input compression by magic; IdXMLFile store uses a plain ofstream regardless of suffix.
FileHandler load checks detected type against allowed types; store falls back to a single allowed type only for unknown filename type.
native_boundaries: Owned result/atomic replacement and file publication.
Only idXML identification adapter; gzip/bzip2 feature-gated; ZIP unavailable.
FileHandler native return preserves document identifier rather than discarding it through vector-only API.
